title: Deficit And Surplus Budget
definition: A budget deficit occurs when government expenditures exceed its total revenues, requiring borrowings or asset sales, whereas a surplus budget arises when revenues surpass expenditures, allowing for debt reduction or reserve accumulation.
importanceInUpsc: Central to Indian Economy syllabus under Public Finance, Fiscal Policy, Macroeconomic stability, and federal fiscal relations; frequently tested in both Prelims (budget metrics, FRBM Act) and Mains (fiscal consolidation, capital expenditure quality).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Deficit And Surplus Budget.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Union Budget and Government Receipts and Expenditures
